meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 命令行工具的安装状态,找出过期、走样或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 Codex 安装后行为异常,想确认本地环境是否需要更新或修复
copy.tagline_en: Health-check your Codex CLI install and flag stale, drifted, or broken setups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if Codex acts up after an install or update and you want your local setup audited

howto.what: 它检查你本机的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 安装,与最新源码逐项比对,给出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每条结论都附上得出它的命令输出或文件。只做诊断,不改动你的安装、配置或代码仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex 等名称,或安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 表现异常、怀疑安装陈旧或损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一次 LazyCodex doctor 检查
say.note: 输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告并附证据

say.text: 我更新 Codex 后行为怪怪的,查一下安装有没有问题
say.note: 会与最新源码比对并给出修复建议

say.text: 检查 Astra(gpt-6-astra)在我这里是否就绪
say.note: 看 Codex 版本是否达到 0.153.1 及模型缓存

howto.what_en: It inspects your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install, compares it with the latest sources, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where each verdict cites its evidence. It only diagnoses — it never changes your install, config, or repos.
howto.when_en: When you ask for a doctor or health check, say LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, or omo-codex, or Codex acts oddly after an install, update, or config change, or you suspect a stale or broken setup.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex doctor check for me
say_en.note: Prints a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence

say_en.text: Codex has acted oddly since my last update; check the install
say_en.note: Compares against latest sources and suggests fixes

say_en.text: Is Astra (gpt-6-astra) ready in my Codex?
say_en.note: Checks version >=0.153.1 and the model cache
